summary: Liberty Star Uranium & Metals Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement with 1800 Diagonal Lending LLC for a $73,700 convertible promissory note bearing 8% interest and a 10% original issue discount, maturing January 15, 2027. The note is convertible into common shares. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation. No premium, board recommendation, or structural special-situation elements are present; it is a standard debt instrument for working capital.
